title: I1 Commit the deployed lab stack template as source
description: The cyclotron-console stack (SAM) has no template in any repo. Reconstruct it from the deployed template (read-only get-template) into infra/ with a deploy runbook; no AWS writes; must match the deployed template.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Evidence: infra/lab/template.yaml reconstructed from get-template (Original). Original and Processed deployed templates are identical and have no Transform (already SAM-expanded plain CloudFormation), so template.yaml is that document in YAML. scripts/dev/check_lab_template.sh --live: 'template.yaml vs snapshot: MATCH; template.yaml vs deployed cyclotron-console (Original): MATCH; 21 resources, 10 parameters'. tests/test_lab_template.py runs offline in make test. make check exit 0 (2291 passed, 1 skipped; trace-ui 269 passed). Package build recipe is not recorded in the repo; README documents the unverified inference. AWS access was read-only. Branch infra/lab-stack-source.
